resourceEffects._doc: How the goods/military/trade/construction resource bonuses are applied. A resource on the tile counts in full, one within `radius` hexes at `nearbyWeight`; the summed fraction is capped at `cap`. Each scale turns that fraction into the effect: settlement goods output x(1+f*goods), recruit cost x(1-f*recruitCost), kingdom army regrowth x(1+f*armyRegen), settlement trade-route income x(1+f*routeIncome), player caravan profit x(1+f*caravanProfit), sale prices +f*salePrice, build cost x(1-f*buildCost), build time x(1-f*buildTime), settlement repairs x(1+f*repair).

seasons._doc: The agricultural year (src/world/seasons.js). curves: output multiplier per season, normalised to a yearly mean of 1 so totals hold. propertyCurves: which curve each player property follows. priceCurves: [dayOfYear 1-120, price modifier] anchors, interpolated and wrapping. lean: late-winter/early-spring windows when settlements with under reserveDays of food lose up to maxPenalty happiness (step points a day). campaign: x kingdom war-declaration chance. eventSeasons: x a timed world event's pick weight.

SHIELD_WALL.name: Shield Wall

WAR_GALLEY.name: War Galley
WAR_GALLEY.description: Oared warship. Never fights on land: it escorts your ships at sea and blockades coastal settlements you raid or besiege. Recruited only at ports.

SCOUT.name: Scout
SCOUT.description: Fast reconnaissance: +1 vision radius and +1 movement per day while in your army

navalRules._doc: How much of each domain fights in each theatre. land = inland battles, coastal = raids/sieges on a port settlement, sea = fights on water. escortShare = part of the war-galley squadron strength added to every fight your own ships take on at sea.

kingdomNavy._doc: Royal fleets of the AI kingdoms (src/world/kingdomNavy.js). A realm keeps perPort strength per port settlement (+capitalPort if its capital is a port), x the best traitMultiplier, and never more than treasury / reservePerStrength. It builds buildRate of the gap a day at buildCost gold per point and pays upkeep gold per point a day. In a war fleets meet (battle.chance a day); a fleet with blockade.superiority over the enemy's blockades its ports: income falls by incomeLoss x the realm's port share, the attacker storms its ports with +siegeBonus, and its port markets pay marketSell / charge marketBuy, or close when the blockader is tightRatio times stronger. Hostile fleets intercept the player's ships within intercept.radius of their ports. liegeService: galleys a sworn player lends the liege's fleet in war.

sieges._doc: Sieges as operations (src/systems/sieges.js). Investing a settlement starts a siege; each day the defenders eat their stores, lose morale and may fall sick, while the camp forages and eats from the packs, may fall sick and desert. Stances: blockade (tighten the cordon), works (build an engine), sap (dig a mine under the walls). Storm, negotiate terms, fight a relief host or lift the siege.

ironborn.name: Ironborn
ironborn.ancestralMemory: The Ironborn remember the First Forge, deep in the Ashpeak mountains, where their ancestors tamed fire and steel.

crownlanders.name: Crownlanders
crownlanders.proverb: "A crown is earned at the table, not the battlefield."
crownlanders.ancestralMemory: The Crownlanders trace their line to the River Council, where seven chieftains broke bread and swore the First Compact.

shieldfolk.name: Shieldfolk
shieldfolk.ancestralMemory: The Shieldfolk were born from the Wardens who stood against the Shadow Tide, holding the passes when all seemed lost.

mosswalkers.name: Mosswalkers
mosswalkers.proverb: "The forest speaks to those who learn to be still."
mosswalkers.ancestralMemory: The Mosswalkers believe they were the first to hear the Heartwood sing — the deep vibration of the oldest tree in creation.

canopiers.name: Canopiers
canopiers.proverb: "Those who fear falling never learn to fly."
canopiers.ancestralMemory: The Canopiers say their first mother climbed the World-Tree and never came down, building the first sky-village among its branches.

rootkeepers.name: Rootkeepers
rootkeepers.proverb: "Every oak was once an acorn with the courage to grow."
rootkeepers.ancestralMemory: The Rootkeepers guard the Seed Vaults — ancient caches of every plant that ever lived, hidden in root caverns.

windrunners.name: Windrunners
windrunners.proverb: "A Windrunner tied down is a Windrunner already dead."
windrunners.ancestralMemory: They say the first Windrunner caught the tail of a cyclone and rode it across the steppe, mapping every horizon.

sandshapers.name: Sandshapers
sandshapers.proverb: "The desert gives nothing freely — and teaches everything."
sandshapers.ancestralMemory: The Sandshapers remember the Year of Glass, when lightning struck the great dunes and their ancestors forged the first desert-glass mirrors.

bonecarvers.name: Bonecarvers
bonecarvers.proverb: "Honor the beast, and its spirit will run with you forever."
bonecarvers.ancestralMemory: The Bonecarvers carry the Great Tusk — a mammoth bone inscribed with the names of every tribe elder for a thousand years.

sunweavers.name: Sunweavers
sunweavers.proverb: "Every dawn is proof that darkness cannot last."
sunweavers.ancestralMemory: The Sunweavers tell of a time when the sun died for three days, and their ancestor wove a cloth of pure light to call it back.

ashpilgrims.name: Ashpilgrims
ashpilgrims.ancestralMemory: The Ashpilgrims were born when a volcano buried their village. The survivors walked through the ash for forty days and emerged enlightened.

starcallers.name: Starcallers
starcallers.proverb: "We are all stardust, remembering where we came from."
starcallers.ancestralMemory: The Starcallers claim their founder once climbed a tower so high she touched the stars and brought back a fragment of cosmic truth.

tidecallers.name: Tidecallers
tidecallers.proverb: "The tide waits for no one, but rewards those who know its rhythm."
tidecallers.ancestralMemory: The Tidecallers built the first sea-wall — a living barrier of coral and stone that protected their village from the Great Tsunami.

deepdivers.name: Deepdivers
deepdivers.proverb: "The greatest treasures are found where others fear to go."
deepdivers.ancestralMemory: The Deepdivers discovered the Sunken City — an ancient civilization beneath the waves — and traded its secrets for generations.

sailweavers.name: Sailweavers
sailweavers.proverb: "A good ship and a fair wind — what more could the heart desire?"
sailweavers.ancestralMemory: The Sailweavers built the Eternal Fleet — ships so masterfully crafted that some still sail, crewed by the descendants of their original builders.

lorekeepers.name: Lorekeepers
lorekeepers.proverb: "A people without records are a people without roots."
lorekeepers.ancestralMemory: The Lorekeepers descend from the Archivists of the Sunken Library, who saved ten thousand scrolls from the Great Flood by carrying them on their backs across the mountains.

thornwardens.name: Thornwardens
thornwardens.proverb: "Beauty and pain grow from the same stem."
thornwardens.ancestralMemory: The Thornwardens grew the Great Briar Wall — a living barrier of thorns a hundred feet high — that held back an invading army for a generation.

frostborn.name: Frostborn
frostborn.proverb: "The cold does not care. And neither shall we."
frostborn.ancestralMemory: The Frostborn survived the Long Winter — seven years of endless snow — by building cities inside glaciers and learning to farm the frost itself.

icewalkers.name: Icewalkers
icewalkers.proverb: "Walk softly on the ice, for the world is thin beneath us."
icewalkers.ancestralMemory: The Icewalkers once followed a white elk across a frozen ocean for forty days, discovering a hidden land of hot springs where they built their sacred winter refuge.

aurorans.name: Aurorans
aurorans.proverb: "The lights above are the dreams of the earth."
aurorans.ancestralMemory: The Aurorans believe their ancestors once spoke with the aurora itself, learning the language of light, and that each color carries a different truth.

deepdelvers.name: Deepdelvers
deepdelvers.proverb: "Dig deep enough and you will find the bones of the world."
deepdelvers.ancestralMemory: The Deepdelvers carved the Underhall — a cathedral-sized cavern deep beneath the mountains — where every surface glitters with embedded gems left by ancient rivers.

glowkin.name: Glowkin
glowkin.proverb: "In the deepest dark, we became our own light."
glowkin.ancestralMemory: The Glowkin were once surface dwellers who fled a great catastrophe underground, and over generations learned to cultivate the living lights of the deep caves.

crystalsmiths.name: Crystalsmiths
crystalsmiths.proverb: "Perfection is not achieved — it is revealed, facet by facet."
crystalsmiths.ancestralMemory: The Crystalsmiths discovered the Singing Cavern — a place where crystals of impossible size hum in perfect harmony, said to be the heartbeat of the world itself.

runespeakers.name: Runespeakers
runespeakers.proverb: "Every word carved in stone outlasts the hand that carved it."
runespeakers.ancestralMemory: The Runespeakers claim their founder discovered the First Rune — a symbol of such power it split a mountain in two — and swore to guard it and all runes that followed.

veilwalkers.name: Veilwalkers
veilwalkers.proverb: "The veil is thin for those with eyes to see."
veilwalkers.ancestralMemory: The Veilwalkers arose at a place where the world is thin — a misty bog where the living and the dead can speak. They serve as intermediaries between realms.

dreamweavers.name: Dreamweavers
dreamweavers.proverb: "What we dream tonight, the world becomes tomorrow."
dreamweavers.ancestralMemory: The Dreamweavers learned to weave shared dreams — a single night where an entire tribe dreams together — and from those visions, they built their first city.

skyherders.name: Skyherders
skyherders.proverb: "From the heights, all borders are illusions."
skyherders.ancestralMemory: The Skyherders followed the great eagles to the roof of the world, where they discovered hidden valleys above the clouds and built the Sky Roads — mountain paths only they can navigate.

reefbuilders.name: Reefbuilders
reefbuilders.proverb: "Build with the sea, not against it, and your walls will outlast stone."
reefbuilders.ancestralMemory: The Reefbuilders grew an entire island from living coral over seven generations — a testament to patience and cooperation that stands to this day.

embersmiths.name: Embersmiths
embersmiths.proverb: "We do not fear the fire — we are the fire."
embersmiths.ancestralMemory: The Embersmiths were born when a volcano's heart cracked open and their ancestors dared to reach inside, pulling out the first Everflame — a fire that has never gone out.

marshborn.name: Marshborn
marshborn.proverb: "The swamp swallows the proud and shelters the humble."
marshborn.ancestralMemory: The Marshborn fled into the deepest bogs when invaders came, and the swamp hid them so well that their enemies believed them vanished. They have never left.

WORKSHOP.name: Workshop

FISHING_WHARF.name: Fishing Wharf
FISHING_WHARF.description: Send boats to collect fish from nearby waters. Upkeep: 10g/day

BREWERY.name: Brewery
BREWERY.description: Brews beer from grain or distills liquor. Sells well at taverns. Upkeep: 8g/day

TAVERN.name: Tavern
TAVERN.description: A place for drink, gambling, and gossip. Earns gold daily from patrons. Upkeep: 8g/day

BAKERY.description: Bakes bread from flour. Requires flour supply. Upkeep: 8g/day

FORGE.name: Forge
FORGE.description: A dedicated smithy. Forges tools or weapons from iron, or casts bronze ware from copper. Upkeep: 12g/day

TANNERY.name: Tannery
TANNERY.description: Tans animal hides into leather, leather armor or parchment. Upkeep: 8g/day

SAWMILL.name: Sawmill
SAWMILL.description: Processes timber into firewood and lumber. Upkeep: 7g/day

QUARRY.name: Quarry
QUARRY.description: Cuts stone blocks from rocky outcrops. Essential for construction. Upkeep: 8g/day

SALT_PANS.name: Salt Pans
SALT_PANS.description: Evaporates seawater to harvest salt. A vital food preservative. Upkeep: 6g/day

APIARY.name: Apiary
APIARY.description: Keeps beehives for honey. Used in mead and candle-making. Upkeep: 6g/day

ORCHARD.name: Orchard
ORCHARD.description: Cultivates fruit trees for winemaking or fresh trade. Upkeep: 6g/day

HEMP_FARM.name: Hemp Farm
HEMP_FARM.description: Grows hemp fiber for rope-making. Vital for ships and construction. Upkeep: 5g/day

CLAY_PIT.name: Clay Pit
CLAY_PIT.description: Digs raw clay from riverbeds. Used for pottery. Upkeep: 4g/day

DAIRY.name: Dairy
DAIRY.description: Raises dairy cattle to produce aged cheese. Popular with traders. Upkeep: 6g/day

SMOKEHOUSE.name: Smokehouse
SMOKEHOUSE.description: Smokes fish and cures meat for long-term preservation. Upkeep: 6g/day

BUTCHER.name: Butcher
BUTCHER.description: Processes hunted game and livestock into dried provisions. Upkeep: 5g/day

ROPE_WALK.name: Rope Walk
ROPE_WALK.description: Twists hemp fiber into rope. Vital for ships and construction. Upkeep: 5g/day

POTTERY_KILN.name: Pottery Kiln
POTTERY_KILN.description: Fires clay pots and vessels for households and traders. Upkeep: 5g/day

WEAVER.name: Weaver
WEAVER.description: Weaves wool into cloth and sews fine garments. Upkeep: 6g/day

WINERY.name: Winery
WINERY.description: Ferments fruit into wine and honey into mead. Premium beverages. Upkeep: 8g/day

APOTHECARY.name: Apothecary
APOTHECARY.description: Prepares herbal remedies and alchemical potions. Upkeep: 8g/day

FLETCHER.name: Fletcher
FLETCHER.description: Crafts arrows and bows for hunters and archers. Upkeep: 6g/day

JEWELER.name: Jeweler
JEWELER.description: Cuts gems and crafts fine jewelry for nobility. Upkeep: 10g/day

DYE_WORKS.name: Dye Works
DYE_WORKS.description: Extracts natural dyes from berries and plants. Upkeep: 6g/day

CHANDLERY.name: Chandlery
CHANDLERY.description: Renders beeswax into candles. An essential light source. Upkeep: 5g/day

GLASSWORKS.name: Glassworks
GLASSWORKS.description: Melts stone into glass and blows glass into lanterns. Upkeep: 10g/day

SCRIPTORIUM.name: Scriptorium
SCRIPTORIUM.description: Monks and scribes prepare parchment and copy rare texts. Upkeep: 8g/day

BLACKSMITH.name: Blacksmith
BLACKSMITH.description: Versatile smithy producing shields, tools, and weapons. Upkeep: 10g/day

PERFUMERY.name: Perfumery
PERFUMERY.description: Distils flowers and resins into perfumes and incense. Upkeep: 8g/day

HUNTING_LODGE.name: Hunting Lodge
HUNTING_LODGE.description: Hunters bring back hides for tanneries and scriptoriums. Upkeep: 5g/day

CATTLE_RANCH.name: Cattle Ranch
CATTLE_RANCH.description: Raises cattle for meat. Pair with a Smokehouse or Butcher for dried provisions. Built on or beside a cattle herd it yields 30% more. Upkeep: 6g/day

HERB_GARDEN.name: Herb Garden
HERB_GARDEN.description: Grows medicinal and aromatic herbs for apothecaries and perfumeries. Upkeep: 4g/day

HORSE_RANCH.name: Horse Ranch
HORSE_RANCH.description: Breeds horses — slow to raise but prized by every army and merchant. Upkeep: 12g/day

PITCH_WORKS.name: Pitch Works
PITCH_WORKS.description: Skims rock oil from a desert seep. Sell it, or refine it into lamp oil at a Chandlery. Upkeep: 8g/day

FORAGER_HUT.name: Forager's Hut
FORAGER_HUT.description: Gathers wild berries and mushrooms. Supplies Dye Works. Upkeep: 3g/day

COPPER.name: Copper
COPPER.description: Smelted copper from the hill mines. The founders cast it into bronze; tinkers and coppersmiths use the rest.

BRONZE.name: Bronze Ware
BRONZE.description: Pots, bells, lamps, buckles and ship's fittings, cast from the copper of these hills (its own arsenic hardens it: no tin needed).

LEATHER.name: Leather
LEATHER.description: Tanned hide. Townsfolk wear it out as boots, belts and harness; tanneries make it from hides.

FOOD.name: Army Rations
FOOD.description: Hardtack and salt pork seized from soldiers. Eaten on the road like any other food.

COAL.name: Coal
COAL.description: Mined from coal seams. Smiths and smelters burn it: forges near coal work faster, and a furnace makes ingots from less iron with it.

OIL.name: Rock Oil
OIL.description: Black oil from desert seeps. A prized trade good; chandlers refine it into lamp oil.

LAMP_OIL.name: Lamp Oil
LAMP_OIL.description: Refined oil for lamps and lanterns.

RUM.name: Rum
RUM.description: Pirate rum. A swig puts spring back in your step (+1 movement today).

HOLY_WATER.name: Holy Water
HOLY_WATER.description: Blessed water carried by pilgrims. Drink it to mend small wounds (+10 health).

RELICS.name: Holy Relics
RELICS.description: Bones and tokens of saints. A pious lord treasures them; a House that enshrines them gains standing.

SCRIPTURES.name: Scriptures
SCRIPTURES.description: Illuminated holy texts. A modest courtly gift.

POISON.name: Poison
POISON.description: Smuggled poison. Fences pay well and ask nothing.

FORGED_DOCUMENTS.name: Forged Documents
FORGED_DOCUMENTS.description: Passable letters of introduction. Carrying them helps a little at the negotiating table (+2%).

RARE_HERBS.name: Rare Herbs
RARE_HERBS.description: Exotic herbs. An apothecary brews them into an Elixir of Vigor.

ANCIENT_ARTIFACT.name: Ancient Artifact
ANCIENT_ARTIFACT.description: A relic of a lost age from a creature's hoard. Lords covet it; enshrined in your hall it brings your House prestige.

ENCHANTED_WEAPON.name: Enchanted Weapon
ENCHANTED_WEAPON.description: A rune-etched blade from a legendary hoard. Carried at the head of your army it adds 5% battle power.

DRAGON_SCALE.name: Dragon Scale
DRAGON_SCALE.description: A plate of scale harder than steel. Carried as a buckler it turns 10% of the harm you take; a blacksmith can work three into dragonscale armour.

DRAGONSCALE_ARMOR.name: Dragonscale Armour
DRAGONSCALE_ARMOR.description: Armour of dragon scale. Turns 25% of the harm you take, and kings would trade a province for it.

ROYAL_SEAL.name: Royal Seal
ROYAL_SEAL.description: A sovereign's signet. Carrying it lends you authority in negotiation (+5%); returned to a lord it earns real gratitude.

TREATY.name: Sealed Treaty
TREATY.description: Signed terms between courts. Useful leverage at the table (+3% negotiation), or a gift a lord will value.

GIFT_CHEST.name: Gift Chest
GIFT_CHEST.description: A chest of courtly presents meant for a lord. Present it at a royal audience.

FINE_WINE.name: Fine Wine
FINE_WINE.description: A vintage fit for a royal table. A small courtly gift.

CURSED_IDOL.name: Cursed Idol
CURSED_IDOL.description: A grinning idol carried up out of a delve. While you carry it the curse saps a little health and karma each day and dogs your luck below ground. Sell it or be rid of it some other way.

CAST_BRONZE.name: Cast Bronze
CAST_BRONZE.description: Melt copper (its own arsenic hardens it) and cast pots, bells and fittings.

BEER.name: Brew Beer
BEER.description: Brew ale from grain. Popular at taverns.

LIQUOR.name: Distill Liquor
LIQUOR.description: Distill strong spirits from grain. High value.

LEATHER_ARMOR.name: Tan Leather Armor
LEATHER_ARMOR.description: Cure hides into protective leather armor.

DRIED_MEAT.name: Cure Dried Meat
DRIED_MEAT.description: Cure raw meat into dried provisions.

POTTERY.name: Fire Pottery
POTTERY.description: Fire clay into pots and vessels.

TAN_LEATHER.name: Tan Leather
TAN_LEATHER.description: Cure hides into leather for the town's cobblers and saddlers.

SHIELD.name: Forge Shield
SHIELD.description: Hammer iron into a sturdy shield.

ARROWS.name: Fletch Arrows
ARROWS.description: Whittle and tip arrows for archers.

BOW.name: Craft Bow
BOW.description: Bend a yew stave into a longbow.

HEALING_SALVE.name: Brew Healing Salve
HEALING_SALVE.description: Infuse herbs into a medicinal salve.

POTION.name: Brew Potion
POTION.description: Brew mushrooms into a mysterious potion.

IRON_INGOT.name: Smelt Iron Ingots
IRON_INGOT.description: Smelt iron into ingots. Coal nearby fires the furnace hotter.

DRAGONSCALE_ARMOR.name: Forge Dragonscale Armour
DRAGONSCALE_ARMOR.description: Rivet dragon scales into a suit of armour.

LAMP_OIL.name: Refine Lamp Oil
LAMP_OIL.description: Refine rock oil into clean-burning lamp oil.

ELIXIR.name: Brew Elixir of Vigor
ELIXIR.description: Brew rare herbs into a restorative elixir.

MERCHANT_APPRENTICE.title: Merchant Apprentice
MERCHANT_APPRENTICE.description: Prove yourself as a trader by accumulating wealth.

TRADE_EMPIRE.title: Trade Empire
TRADE_EMPIRE.description: Build a network of profitable properties.

MERCENARY_CAPTAIN.title: Mercenary Captain
MERCENARY_CAPTAIN.description: Complete mercenary contracts to build your reputation.

PROPHET.title: Prophet
PROPHET.description: Found your own religion and spread the faith.

TEMPLE_BUILDER.title: Temple Builder
TEMPLE_BUILDER.description: Construct religious buildings to spread your faith.

A_NEW_BEGINNING.title: A New Beginning
A_NEW_BEGINNING.description: Explore nearby lands, discover settlements, and grow your influence.

WANDERER.title: Wanderer
WANDERER.description: Explore the world and discover new lands.

MARKET_MANIPULATOR.title: Market Manipulator
MARKET_MANIPULATOR.description: Buy low and sell high — dominate the trade markets.

SILK_ROAD.title: The Silk Road
SILK_ROAD.description: Establish long-distance trade routes across the realm.

BANDIT_SLAYER.title: Bandit Slayer
BANDIT_SLAYER.description: Clear the roads of bandits and raiders.

HOLY_CRUSADER.title: Holy Crusader
HOLY_CRUSADER.description: Spread your faith through righteous combat.

MIRACLE_WORKER_QUEST.title: Miracle Worker
MIRACLE_WORKER_QUEST.description: Perform divine miracles to prove your devotion.

PILGRIMAGE.title: The Great Pilgrimage
PILGRIMAGE.description: Visit every holy site in the realm.

HERESY_HUNTER.title: Heresy Hunter
HERESY_HUNTER.description: Root out heretical movements threatening the faith.

TREASURE_HUNTER.title: Treasure Hunter
TREASURE_HUNTER.description: Find hidden treasures scattered across the realm.

MOUNTAIN_CLIMBER.title: Mountain Climber
MOUNTAIN_CLIMBER.description: Traverse the highest mountain peaks in the realm.

DIPLOMAT.title: Diplomat
DIPLOMAT.description: Establish diplomatic relations with multiple kingdoms.

KINGMAKER.title: Kingmaker
KINGMAKER.description: Become so influential you can sway the fate of kingdoms.

SPY_NETWORK.title: Spy Network
SPY_NETWORK.description: Build an intelligence network throughout the realm.

TAVERN_REGULAR.title: Tavern Regular
TAVERN_REGULAR.description: Become a well-known figure in the taverns of the realm.

SCHOLAR.title: Scholar
SCHOLAR.description: Research new technologies to advance your domain.

DRAGON_HUNTER.title: Dragon Hunter
DRAGON_HUNTER.description: Track and slay the legendary beasts terrorizing the land.

PEOPLES_CHAMPION.title: People's Champion
PEOPLES_CHAMPION.description: Help the common folk with their problems.

DIVINE_MANDATE.title: Divine Mandate
DIVINE_MANDATE.description: Become the supreme religious authority in the realm.

PHYSICIANS_HERBS.title: A Physician's Herbs
PHYSICIANS_HERBS.description: The town physician has run out of herbs for poultices and fever draughts. Gather them in the wild and bring them to her.

FURS_FOR_WINTER.title: Furs for the Winter
FURS_FOR_WINTER.description: The furrier's racks are bare and the cold months are coming. Hunt the wilds and bring back pelts.

TOMB_OF_THE_OLD_KINGS.title: Tomb of the Old Kings
TOMB_OF_THE_OLD_KINGS.description: A scholar will pay for an account of a buried tomb, taken all the way down to the burial chamber.

objectives.text: Clear a Buried Tomb delve to the bottom

THE_DEEP_SEAM.title: The Deep Seam
THE_DEEP_SEAM.description: The miners' guild wants to know whether an abandoned mine can be worked again. Go to the bottom and come back.

objectives.text: Clear an Abandoned Mine delve to the bottom

THE_BLIND_DARK.title: The Blind Dark
THE_BLIND_DARK.description: Herders swear something lives at the bottom of the caves above the valley. Find out.

objectives.text: Clear a Deep Cave delve to the bottom

THE_DROWNED_HALLS.title: The Drowned Halls
THE_DROWNED_HALLS.description: Sunken ruins hold the treasures of a city the sea took. Few who go down reach the last hall.

objectives.text: Clear a Sunken Ruins delve to the bottom

BREAD_FOR_THE_BESIEGED.title: Bread for the Besieged
BREAD_FOR_THE_BESIEGED.description: A town is shut in by a besieging host and its stores are running low. Get provisions through the lines.

objectives.text: Get supplies into a besieged holding, or fulfil a siege-relief contract

CONVOY_ESCORT.title: Escort the Convoys
CONVOY_ESCORT.description: Bandits and pirates prey on the trade roads. See your company's convoys safely to their posts and contract towns.

COMPANY_CONTRACTS.title: A Name for Reliability
COMPANY_CONTRACTS.description: The great houses trust a company that delivers. Fulfil supply contracts in full.

THE_RUMOURED_ISLE.title: The Rumoured Isle
THE_RUMOURED_ISLE.description: Sailors in the taverns talk of an island no chart shows. Hear the rumour (or buy a chart) and find the place.

objectives.text: Discover a land a rumour or a chart spoke of

NAME_THE_NEW_LAND.title: Name the New Land
NAME_THE_NEW_LAND.description: The royal cartographers will pay for a land no one has charted, and for the right to print its name.

A_SEASONED_CREW.title: A Seasoned Crew
A_SEASONED_CREW.description: A green crew becomes a good one only at sea. Make real voyages, port to port.

RUN_THE_BLOCKADE.title: Run the Blockade
RUN_THE_BLOCKADE.description: An enemy fleet has closed a realm's harbours and its towns pay anything for goods. Smuggle a cargo past the patrols and sell it on the black market.

objectives.text: Sell goods on the black market in a blockaded realm

SLAY_THE_SAGA_BEAST.title: Slay the Beast of the Saga
SLAY_THE_SAGA_BEAST.description: A creature out of the old songs walks the land and a realm has put a price on its head. Hunt it down.

SATISFACTION_DEMANDED.title: Satisfaction Demanded
SATISFACTION_DEMANDED.description: A rival adventurer has been boasting in every tavern that you are a coward. Answer with steel.

objectives.text: Win a duel against a rival adventurer

THE_MERCIFUL_HAND.title: The Merciful Hand
THE_MERCIFUL_HAND.description: The priests say a lord is measured by the mercy shown to those who kneel. Rule with mercy when petitioners come.

THE_IRON_LAW.title: The Iron Law
THE_IRON_LAW.description: Your stewards complain that the folk think your law is soft. Show them its weight from the bench.

SCALES_OF_JUSTICE.title: Scales of Justice
SCALES_OF_JUSTICE.description: A travelling jurist wants to see whether your court weighs a case fairly. Give a just ruling.

objectives.text: Rule on a petition with justice

WALLS_AND_WORKS.title: Walls and Works
WALLS_AND_WORKS.description: A holding that does not grow falls behind. Raise new works in your settlements.

RAIDERS_AT_THE_GATE.title: Raiders at the Gate
RAIDERS_AT_THE_GATE.description: Bandits have been probing the edges of your lands. Make sure the next raid breaks on your walls.

objectives.text: Repel a raid on one of your holdings

TAKE_THE_TOWN.title: Take the Town
TAKE_THE_TOWN.description: A walled town will not open its gates to anything but a siege. Invest it, starve or storm it, and take it.

NO_RELIEF_FOR_THEM.title: No Relief for Them
NO_RELIEF_FOR_THEM.description: The besieged are waiting for their king's army. Meet it in the field before it reaches the walls.

objectives.text: Beat a relief army marching on your siege

BY_ROYAL_DECREE.title: By Royal Decree
BY_ROYAL_DECREE.description: A new reign is judged by its first laws. Put an edict before your council and see it passed.

THE_KINGMAKERS_WAGER.title: The Kingmaker's Wager
THE_KINGMAKERS_WAGER.description: A throne stands empty and the claimants are gathering. Back the one who will win it.

objectives.text: Back the winning claimant in a succession crisis

HONOUR_AMONG_THIEVES.title: Honour Among Thieves
HONOUR_AMONG_THIEVES.description: The Guild's contact wants to see what you can do before trusting you with more.

objectives.text: Commit 3 crimes (jobs, black-market deals, fencing, theft)

A_FRIEND_INDEED.title: A Friend Indeed
A_FRIEND_INDEED.description: Those who travel with you follow for pay. Earn one companion's devotion.

courtingStages.label: Strangers
courtingStages.description: You don't know each other yet.

chat.label: Have a Chat
chat.description: Strike up a conversation. Low reward, always available.

compliment.label: Give a Compliment
compliment.description: Offer a sincere compliment. Charisma helps.

gift.label: Give a Gift
gift.description: Buy a thoughtful gift. Costs gold.

moonlight_walk.label: Moonlight Walk
moonlight_walk.description: Take a quiet walk together to deepen connection.

romantic_dinner.label: Romantic Dinner
romantic_dinner.description: Invite them to a lavish dinner. Requires a settlement.

private_vows.label: Exchange Private Vows
private_vows.description: Pledge devotion in private before the wedding.

propose.label: Propose Marriage
propose.description: Ask for their hand in marriage. Must be deeply in love.

quality_time.label: Spend Quality Time
quality_time.description: Invest in your marriage and keep affection strong.

befriend.label: Be Friendly
befriend.description: Make small talk and build rapport.

share_meal.label: Share a Meal
share_meal.description: Break bread together. Costs a little gold.

tell_stories.label: Tell Stories
tell_stories.description: Share tales and listen to theirs.

train_together.label: Train Together
train_together.description: Spar or drill with this person. Builds respect.

confide_secret.label: Confide a Secret
confide_secret.description: Trust them with a private truth. Great reward if it lands.

blood_oath.label: Swear Blood Oath
blood_oath.description: Bind your loyalty in solemn ritual. Powerful, but risky.

challenge.label: Challenge to Duel
challenge.description: Challenge them to a friendly (or not) duel.

giftItems.name: Gold Ring
giftItems.description: A gleaming ring of fine gold.

giftItems.name: Fine Blade
giftItems.description: A well-forged weapon. Martial types appreciate this.

giftItems.name: Rare Book
giftItems.description: A book of knowledge or poetry.

{npc} surprises you with a small gift — a {item}.

solaris.name: The Solar Covenant
solaris.description: Worship of the Eternal Sun — the oldest surviving faith. Temples face east, and adherents mark holy days at dawn.

tidemother.name: Faith of the Tidemother
tidemother.description: Seafarers' faith centred on the Tidemother — goddess of currents, storms, and safe harbour.

earthroot.name: The Earthroot Communion
earthroot.description: Nature worship venerating the world-tree whose roots bind all living things. Shrines stand in forest glades.

ironfaith.name: The Iron Creed
ironfaith.description: Born among mountain clans, the Iron Creed teaches that the soul is forged through trial and labour.

starseers.name: Order of the Starseers
starseers.description: Mystic scholar-monks who chart the heavens and claim to read fate in the constellations.

stoneheart.name: The Stoneheart Pact
stoneheart.description: Mountain-dwellers who believe the gods sleep inside stone and that every carved hall is a prayer.

serpentway.name: The Serpent's Way
serpentway.description: Swamp mystics who worship the Great Serpent — symbol of death, rebirth, and the cycle of decay and renewal.

arcanum.name: The Arcane Orthodoxy
arcanum.description: Less a religion than a philosophical order — practitioners believe magic itself is divine and study is worship.

stormfather.name: Cult of the Stormfather
stormfather.description: Northern raiders worship the Stormfather — god of thunder, war, and the open sea. Sacrifices are made before raids.

dunewalkers.name: The Dunewalker Creed
dunewalkers.description: Desert faith teaching that the gods test mortals with heat and thirst. Water-sharing is the holiest act.

dreamweavers.name: The Dreamweaver Circle
dreamweavers.description: Practitioners enter dream-trances to commune with spirits. They believe waking life is the lesser reality.

ashwalkers.name: The Ashwalker Path
ashwalkers.description: Fire-worshippers who practised ritual immolation. Suppressed after the Great Pyre Rebellion of 230.

voidcallers.name: The Cult of the Void
voidcallers.description: An esoteric cult that worshipped the emptiness between stars. Banned after the Mindbreak Plague of 400.

bonesingers.name: The Bonesinger Rites
bonesingers.description: Ancestor-worship tradition where the dead were preserved and "sang" through wind-harps atop burial spires. Faded after prolonged plague.

flameheralds.name: Heralds of the Eternal Flame
flameheralds.description: A militant offshoot of the Solar Covenant. Launched three crusades before collapsing into internal schism.

bloodmoon.name: The Blood Moon Covenant
bloodmoon.description: Blood-sacrifice cult that performed rituals under the red moon. Eradicated by a combined crusade of the Solar Covenant and Iron Creed.

silentorder.name: The Silent Order
silentorder.description: Monks who took vows of eternal silence, believing all speech corrupted divine truth. Died out when no new followers could be recruited.

Peace.summary: +10% reputation gains; faithful realms warm to you 50% faster

Charity.desc: Give to the poor and needy
Charity.summary: +20% conversion and +0.5 karma a day, but -25% tithes

Justice.desc: Uphold law and punish the wicked
Justice.summary: Each devoted town steadies its realm (+1 stability, up to +3)

Humility.summary: -10% army upkeep and +0.3 karma a day

Sovereignty.desc: Divine right of the faithful to rule
Sovereignty.summary: +5% negotiation with lords; faithful realms warm to you twice as fast

Mysticism.desc: Seek the hidden mysteries of the cosmos

holySiteTypes.name: Sacred Spring
holySiteTypes.description: Blessed waters said to cure ailments

holySiteTypes.name: World-Tree Sapling
holySiteTypes.description: A sapling of the legendary world-tree

holySiteTypes.name: Grand Reliquary
holySiteTypes.description: Repository of sacred relics from many faiths

holySiteTypes.name: Dragon Bone Shrine
holySiteTypes.description: Shrine built around the petrified bones of an ancient dragon

holySiteTypes.name: Crystal Cavern
holySiteTypes.description: Underground cavern where crystals hum with divine resonance

holySiteTypes.name: Storm Peak Altar
holySiteTypes.description: Mountain summit where lightning strikes are divine omens

holySiteTypes.name: Sunken Temple
holySiteTypes.description: Half-submerged ruins of an ancient temple to forgotten gods

holySiteTypes.name: Oasis Shrine
holySiteTypes.description: Desert oasis believed to have been created by divine intervention

holySiteTypes.name: Moonwell
holySiteTypes.description: A still pool that reflects the stars even during daylight

holySiteTypes.name: The Blood Stone
holySiteTypes.description: A crimson megalith that seems to pulse with inner warmth

heresies.name: Dualist Heresy
heresies.description: Claims the divine has both a light and dark aspect, equal in power

heresies.name: Iconoclast Movement
heresies.description: Demands destruction of all religious imagery and relics

heresies.name: Free Prophet Schism
heresies.description: Anyone may declare prophecy — no central authority

heresies.name: Ascetic Revolt
heresies.description: Extreme poverty movement rejecting all temple wealth

heresies.name: Blood Rite Revival
heresies.description: Attempts to revive forbidden sacrificial practices

heresies.name: Wild Faith
heresies.description: Rejects all temples and structure — worship only in the untamed wild

heresies.name: Mechanist Doctrine
heresies.description: Claims the divine is a great machine and prayer is merely engineering

heresies.name: Ancestor Revival
heresies.description: Bonesinger rites resurface — the dead should guide the living

heresies.name: Void Whisper
heresies.description: Secretive resurgence of Void worship, promising forbidden knowledge

heresies.name: Sun-Moon Schism
heresies.description: Solar Covenant splits over whether the moon is the sun's equal or enemy

heresies.name: Living God Movement
heresies.description: A charismatic preacher claims to be a god incarnate

SHRINE.name: Shrine
SHRINE.description: Small place of worship, spreads faith locally

MONASTERY.name: Monastery
MONASTERY.description: Peaceful retreat, generates karma and faith

CATHEDRAL.name: Cathedral
CATHEDRAL.description: Magnificent cathedral, the pinnacle of religious architecture

ORACLE_TOWER.name: Oracle Tower
ORACLE_TOWER.description: A tower where oracles divine the future through ritual and stargazing

PILGRIM_HOSPICE.name: Pilgrim Hospice
PILGRIM_HOSPICE.description: A waystation offering shelter and healing to pilgrims

SACRED_GROVE.name: Sacred Grove
SACRED_GROVE.description: A consecrated woodland clearing for nature worship

RELIQUARY_VAULT.name: Reliquary Vault
RELIQUARY_VAULT.description: A fortified vault housing powerful religious relics

HEALING.name: Divine Healing
HEALING.description: Invoke divine power to heal all wounds

CONVERSION.name: Mass Conversion
CONVERSION.description: Convert many to your faith at once

HARVEST.name: Bountiful Harvest
HARVEST.effect: All farms produce triple for 3 days
HARVEST.description: Invoke divine fertility upon the land

SMITE.name: Divine Smite
SMITE.effect: Deal massive damage to an enemy unit
SMITE.description: Call down divine wrath upon your enemies

REVELATION.name: Revelation
REVELATION.effect: Reveal all tiles in a large radius
REVELATION.description: The divine grants sight beyond mortal ken

SANCTUARY.name: Holy Sanctuary
SANCTUARY.effect: Create a safe zone where no combat can occur for 5 days
SANCTUARY.description: Consecrate the ground so no blood may be shed upon it

RESURRECTION.name: Resurrection
RESURRECTION.effect: Restore a destroyed unit to full strength
RESURRECTION.description: Call the fallen back from beyond the veil

PLAGUE.name: Divine Plague
PLAGUE.description: Unleash a terrible pestilence upon the unfaithful

shipTypes.name: Rowboat
shipTypes.description: A simple wooden rowboat. Slow and vulnerable, but affordable for beginners.

shipTypes.name: Fishing Vessel
shipTypes.description: A sturdy coastal fishing boat. Can handle shallow waters and bring in a catch.

shipTypes.name: Sloop
shipTypes.description: A fast single-masted vessel. Excellent for coastal trading and light combat.

shipTypes.name: Trading Cog
shipTypes.description: A broad-beamed merchant ship built for carrying large cargoes across open seas.

shipTypes.name: Caravel
shipTypes.description: A nimble exploration vessel with lateen sails. Perfect for discovering new lands.

shipTypes.name: War Galley
shipTypes.description: An oar-driven warship built for ram-and-board tactics. Dominates coastal waters.

shipTypes.name: Galleon
shipTypes.description: A massive multi-decked vessel. The queen of the seas — formidable in both trade and war.

customizations.name: Reinforced Hull
customizations.description: Thicker planking and iron bracing to withstand heavy seas and combat.

customizations.name: Extra Sails
customizations.description: Additional sail area for greater speed in favorable winds.

customizations.name: Expanded Cargo Hold
customizations.description: Redesigned hull interior to maximize storage capacity.

customizations.name: Bronze Ram
customizations.description: A reinforced prow for devastating ramming attacks.

customizations.name: Deck Ballista
customizations.description: A mounted siege weapon for ranged naval combat.

customizations.name: Boarding Planks
customizations.description: Drop-bridges for boarding enemy vessels. Improves capture chances.

customizations.name: Navigator's Quarters
customizations.description: Dedicated quarters with charts and instruments. Improves exploration.

customizations.name: Crow's Nest
customizations.description: A high lookout point for spotting land, ships, and danger.

customizations.name: Greek Fire Siphon
customizations.description: A devastating incendiary weapon that can set enemy ships ablaze.

customizations.name: Captain's Luxury Cabin
customizations.description: Opulent quarters that demonstrate your wealth and status.

customizations.name: Improved Oars
customizations.description: Better-crafted oars for improved speed and handling.

customizations.name: Deep-Sea Nets
customizations.description: Professional-grade nets for catching larger hauls.

A salvaged ship, repaired and ready

Impounded by the harbormaster — now for sale
Abandoned and reclaimed from a sandbar

explorationEvents.name: Floating Cargo
explorationEvents.description: You discover drifting crates from a shipwreck.

explorationEvents.name: Uncharted Island
explorationEvents.description: You spot a small island not on any charts. Landing reveals hidden treasures.

explorationEvents.name: Whale Sighting
explorationEvents.description: A magnificent whale breaches near your ship. The crew takes it as a good omen.

explorationEvents.name: Sea Monster!
explorationEvents.description: A tentacled beast rises from the deep and attacks your ship!

explorationEvents.name: Stranded Sailors
explorationEvents.description: You find shipwrecked sailors clinging to debris. Rescue them for karma and information.

explorationEvents.name: Merchant Wreck
explorationEvents.description: The remains of a merchant vessel with salvageable goods.

explorationEvents.name: Calm Seas
explorationEvents.description: Beautiful weather and smooth sailing. Your crew's morale improves.

explorationEvents.name: Sudden Storm
explorationEvents.description: A fierce storm batters your ship. Hold fast!

explorationEvents.name: Pirate Ambush!
explorationEvents.description: Pirates emerge from behind a rocky outcrop!

explorationEvents.name: Dolphins
explorationEvents.description: A pod of dolphins escorts your ship. Sailors say it means good luck.

voyageEvents.title: Becalmed
voyageEvents.text: The wind dies. The sails hang slack and the sea turns to glass.

choices.label: Wait for the wind
choices.text: You lie becalmed for a day while the water casks run low.

choices.label: Man the sweeps
choices.text: The crew rows you through the doldrums, cursing every stroke.

pass.text: A breeze answers before the tune is done. The hands grin.

fail.text: No wind comes, and the old hands mutter that you have angered the sea.

voyageEvents.title: Sail Ho!
voyageEvents.text: A sail on the horizon, hull-down and closing on your course.

pass.text: A merchantman. Her master trades news of the sea lanes and a cask of fresh water.

fail.text: Pirates! They run out their guns as you come alongside.

win.text: You beat them off and take their purse.

lose.text: They board you, take what they like and leave you wallowing.

pass.text: You show her your stern and lose her by nightfall.

fail.text: She is faster. Pirates, and they mean to have you.

win.text: Cornered, your crew fights like devils and drives them off.

lose.text: They take a share of the hold and leave you limping.

choices.label: Run her down (piracy)
choices.text: You hoist no colours and give chase.

win.text: You plunder her hold and set her crew adrift in the boats.

lose.text: Her crew fights back hard, and you sheer off with a holed hull.

voyageEvents.title: A Derelict
voyageEvents.text: A derelict drifts across your bows: masts snapped, sails rotting, not a soul on deck.

pass.text: Her strongroom is intact. You carry off her strongbox and a few bales.

fail.text: Something foul lingered in her hold. The flux breaks out among your men.

choices.label: Strip her timbers
choices.text: Your carpenter strips good oak and spars to patch your own hull.

choices.label: Give her a wide berth
choices.text: The crew crosses themselves as she drifts astern.

voyageEvents.title: Coils in the Swell
voyageEvents.text: The lookout swears he saw great coils rise and sink off the bow. The crew talks of nothing else.

choices.label: Hunt the beast
choices.text: You beat to quarters and go looking for it.

win.text: A sea serpent, and you have slain it. Its teeth will hang in every tavern you drink in.

lose.text: It was real. It stove in your planking and took a man before it sounded.

choices.label: Steer wide of those waters
choices.text: You lose a day going around, and the crew breathes easier.

pass.text: You call it a log and a bellyful of rum, and the crew laughs with you.

fail.text: Nobody laughs. The night watch refuses to go aloft.

voyageEvents.title: Man Overboard!
voyageEvents.text: A sailor goes over the side in a squall. You can see his head in the wake.

pass.text: You haul him aboard half-drowned. The crew will not forget it.

fail.text: You search until dark, but the sea has him.

choices.label: Hold your course
choices.text: You will not risk the ship for one man. The crew watches him fall astern.

voyageEvents.title: St Elmo's Fire
voyageEvents.text: Blue fire crawls along the yards and crackles at the masthead in the dark.

choices.label: Proclaim it a blessing
choices.text: You tell them the saint walks with the ship. They believe you.

choices.label: Lead the crew in prayer
choices.text: The whole ship's company kneels on the wet deck until the fire fades.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.text: The hands whisper about drowned men's lanterns.

voyageEvents.title: A Convoy Asks for Escort
voyageEvents.text: A convoy of fat merchantmen signals you: pirates work these waters, and they will pay for an escort.

choices.label: Escort them
choices.text: You shepherd the convoy along a day's detour.

pass.text: The pirates never show. The merchants pay all the same.

fail.text: Two pirate sloops fall on the convoy at dawn.

win.text: You drive them off. The grateful merchants pay handsomely.

lose.text: The convoy scatters and you take a mauling covering it.

choices.label: Decline
choices.text: You wish them luck and hold your course.

choices.label: Demand protection money
choices.text: They pay, and they will tell every harbourmaster what you did.

voyageEvents.title: A Castaway
voyageEvents.text: A castaway clings to a spar, waving weakly at your sails.

choices.label: Take him aboard
choices.text: Fed and dried, he signs on as a hand.

choices.label: Sail past
choices.text: You have no food to spare. The crew does not meet your eye.

voyageEvents.title: Smugglers' Lugger
voyageEvents.text: A lugger running without lights comes alongside. Cheap wine, she says, and no questions.

choices.label: Buy her wine (120g)
choices.text: Six casks swing into your hold. Somebody's excise man is the poorer.

choices.label: Take her name for the harbourmaster
choices.text: You note her name and course for the next harbourmaster.

choices.label: Send her on her way
choices.text: She melts back into the dark.

voyageEvents.title: A Great Shoal
voyageEvents.text: The sea boils silver: a shoal of herring as far as the eye can see.

choices.label: Cast the nets
choices.text: Fresh fish for every mess and more salted down for the voyage.

choices.label: Press on
choices.text: You do not stop.

voyageEvents.title: Fog Bank
voyageEvents.text: A fog bank swallows the ship. From the helm you cannot see the bowsprit.

pass.text: Leadsman calling every minute, you come out the far side unscathed.

fail.text: A grinding shudder: you have scraped a reef.

choices.label: Heave to until it lifts
choices.text: You lie to for a day, bells ringing in the murk.

voyageEvents.title: Grumbling Below Decks
voyageEvents.text: The hands are muttering: short commons, hard usage, and a captain who doesn't care.

choices.label: Promise a bonus (3g a hand)
choices.text: Coin talks. The muttering stops.

choices.label: Break out extra rations
choices.text: A double ration and a tot all round.

pass.text: The lash restores order, for now.

fail.text: The crew turns sullen. Two hands slip away in the jolly boat that night.

choices.label: Let them grumble
choices.text: It festers.

voyageEvents.title: A Message in a Bottle
voyageEvents.text: A sealed bottle bobs alongside, its cork waxed and stamped.

choices.label: Fish it out and read it

pass.text: A drowned merchant's last words, and the mark of a cache ashore. You find it on the way.

fail.text: A love letter, sadly lettered. The crew reads it aloud at supper, much moved.

choices.label: Leave it to the sea
choices.text: Some messages are not for you.

crew._doc: Sailors are hired at ports and paid daily. A ship below its crewRequired sails slower, fights worse and nets fewer fish; below minCrewShare it cannot leave port. Morale rests at restingMorale; storms, defeats and missed wages lower it, victories raise it, and sailors desert when it falls below desertionMorale.

portPrices._doc: Port prices as multiples of the good's land base price (data/playerEconomy.json GOODS, moved by the season), so sea goods share the land economy's scale. Exporters sell cheap and pay exportResale of their own price; local markets sit around base with a spread; importers pay a premium and sell none. A port whose own town market stocks the good never imports it.

provisions._doc: Ships away from port feed their crew from the hold: one unit of any listed food feeds sailorsPerRation sailors for a day. A ship's chandler at a port sells the provision item at chandlerMarkup over the town's food price (never below minPrice). A crew with nothing to eat loses hungerMoraleLoss morale a day; after scurvyAfterHungryDays hungry days scurvy breaks out aboard, and a broken crew deserts.

voyage._doc: Voyages to a port take real days: each day the ship sails getSailingSpeed hexes along a sea route (half in a storm), and the normal day passes. eventChance is the daily chance of an at-sea event (voyageEvents); logLength caps the voyage log.

farm.description: A dedicated space for agricultural experiments and crop research.

workshop.description: An advanced facility for engineering, metallurgy, and military research.

trading_post.description: A school of commerce, economics, and trade strategy.

harbor.description: A dedicated facility for naval engineering and seamanship research.

library.description: A great hall of study for cultural and educational advancement.

apothecary.description: A facility for researching herbal remedies, surgery, and disease prevention.

CROP_ROTATION.name: Crop Rotation
CROP_ROTATION.description: Rotating crops across fields restores soil nutrients and improves yields.
CROP_ROTATION.flavorText: The land gives more when you give it time to breathe.

IRRIGATION.name: Irrigation Systems
IRRIGATION.description: Channel water to fields for consistent irrigation.

SELECTIVE_BREEDING.name: Selective Breeding
SELECTIVE_BREEDING.description: Breed stronger livestock for better wool and meat.
SELECTIVE_BREEDING.flavorText: Nature perfected through patience and observation.

FERTILIZATION.name: Advanced Fertilization
FERTILIZATION.description: Use composting and manure techniques to dramatically boost farm output.
FERTILIZATION.flavorText: From waste, abundance. The circle of the field is complete.

GRANARY_CONSTRUCTION.name: Granary Construction
GRANARY_CONSTRUCTION.description: Build granaries to store surplus grain and prevent spoilage.
GRANARY_CONSTRUCTION.flavorText: Seven years of plenty shall sustain seven years of famine.

IMPROVED_TOOLS.name: Improved Tools
IMPROVED_TOOLS.description: Better-forged tools increase mining and logging efficiency.
IMPROVED_TOOLS.flavorText: A sharp axe makes light work.

ADVANCED_SMELTING.name: Advanced Smelting
ADVANCED_SMELTING.flavorText: In the heart of the forge, impurities burn away.

WATER_MILL.name: Water Mill
WATER_MILL.description: Harness water power to automate milling and sawing.
WATER_MILL.flavorText: The river works tirelessly so we don't have to.

STONECUTTING.name: Stonecutting
STONECUTTING.description: Cut and shape stone for stronger construction.
STONECUTTING.flavorText: From rough rock, we carve the foundations of empire.

STEEL_FORGING.name: Steel Forging
STEEL_FORGING.description: Forge weapons and armor of superior steel.
STEEL_FORGING.flavorText: Steel that sings when drawn — a craftsman's pride.

BASIC_TRAINING.name: Basic Training
BASIC_TRAINING.description: Organized militia training for better combat performance.
BASIC_TRAINING.flavorText: Even farmers fight better when they know which end of the sword to hold.

ARCHERY_MASTERY.name: Archery Mastery
ARCHERY_MASTERY.description: Advanced bow techniques for deadlier ranged attacks.
ARCHERY_MASTERY.flavorText: Their arrows blot out the sun.

CAVALRY_TACTICS.name: Cavalry Tactics
CAVALRY_TACTICS.description: Mounted combat formations and flanking maneuvers.
CAVALRY_TACTICS.flavorText: A thundering charge to break any shield wall.

SIEGE_ENGINEERING.name: Siege Engineering
SIEGE_ENGINEERING.description: Build siege engines to assault fortified positions.
SIEGE_ENGINEERING.flavorText: No wall can stand against the relentless pounding.

FORTIFICATION.name: Fortification
FORTIFICATION.description: Build defensive walls and watchtowers for your settlements.
FORTIFICATION.flavorText: These walls shall be our unyielding shield.

ROAD_BUILDING.name: Road Building
ROAD_BUILDING.description: Construct dirt roads between hexes to speed travel.
ROAD_BUILDING.flavorText: All great journeys begin with a well-trodden path.

PAVED_ROADS.name: Paved Roads
PAVED_ROADS.description: Stone-paved roads for even faster travel.
PAVED_ROADS.flavorText: Rome endured because its roads did.

BRIDGE_CONSTRUCTION.name: Bridge Construction
BRIDGE_CONSTRUCTION.description: Build bridges to cross rivers and reduce swamp penalties.
BRIDGE_CONSTRUCTION.flavorText: Where rivers once stopped us, bridges carry us onward.

CARTOGRAPHY.name: Cartography
CARTOGRAPHY.description: Map the land to reveal more territory and plan better routes.
CARTOGRAPHY.flavorText: With knowledge of the land comes mastery over it.

AQUEDUCTS.name: Aqueducts
AQUEDUCTS.description: Monumental water channels that boost settlement growth.
AQUEDUCTS.flavorText: Water flows uphill when engineers will it so.

BASIC_ACCOUNTING.name: Basic Accounting
BASIC_ACCOUNTING.description: Better bookkeeping means lower trade losses.
BASIC_ACCOUNTING.flavorText: A lord who knows his ledger commands more than gold.

TRADE_NETWORKS.name: Trade Networks
TRADE_NETWORKS.description: Establish trade routes for higher caravan profits.
TRADE_NETWORKS.flavorText: Connections forged in gold last longer than those in iron.

CURRENCY_MINTING.name: Currency Minting
CURRENCY_MINTING.description: Mint your own coins for more favorable trade terms.
CURRENCY_MINTING.flavorText: A coin with your likeness commands respect in any market.

MERCHANT_GUILD.name: Merchant Guild
MERCHANT_GUILD.description: Found a merchant guild for powerful economic bonuses.
MERCHANT_GUILD.flavorText: United merchants shape the fate of kingdoms.

BANKING_SYSTEMS.name: Banking Systems
BANKING_SYSTEMS.description: Advanced financial institutions and investment returns.
BANKING_SYSTEMS.flavorText: Let money beget money, and prosperity shall follow.

SHIPBUILDING.name: Shipbuilding
SHIPBUILDING.description: Construct seaworthy vessels for trade and exploration. Fleet limit +3 ships.
SHIPBUILDING.flavorText: The first plank laid is a promise to the sea.

NAVIGATION.name: Navigation
NAVIGATION.description: Star charts and compass enable long-distance sea voyages. Ships sail 30% faster; +25% exploration finds.
NAVIGATION.flavorText: By star and compass, the unknown becomes a road.

DEEP_SEA_FISHING.name: Deep Sea Fishing
DEEP_SEA_FISHING.description: Venture into deep waters for bountiful catches. +40% fish from wharf boats and fishing fleets.
DEEP_SEA_FISHING.flavorText: The deep waters teem with silver bounty.

NAVAL_WARFARE.name: Naval Warfare
NAVAL_WARFARE.description: Train marines and outfit warships for sea battles.
NAVAL_WARFARE.flavorText: Command the seas, and the land shall kneel.

LIGHTHOUSE.name: Lighthouse
LIGHTHOUSE.description: Build coastal lighthouses to protect shipping and boost port trade.
LIGHTHOUSE.flavorText: A single flame on the shore saves a thousand souls at sea.

HERBALISM.name: Herbalism
HERBALISM.description: Identify and cultivate medicinal plants for basic remedies. +15% plague resistance.
HERBALISM.flavorText: The forest is the oldest apothecary.

SURGERY.name: Surgery
SURGERY.description: Skilled surgeons save wounded soldiers: -20% battle deaths, and 30% of the fallen are carried off wounded instead (half strength for 5 days).
SURGERY.flavorText: A steady hand and a sharp blade — the surgeon's arts.

PLAGUE_PREVENTION.name: Plague Prevention
PLAGUE_PREVENTION.description: Quarantine protocols and sanitation reduce disease spread. +40% plague resistance.
PLAGUE_PREVENTION.flavorText: Cleanliness wards off death more surely than any sword.

HOSPITAL.name: Hospital
HOSPITAL.description: Establish hospitals for comprehensive healthcare in settlements.
HOSPITAL.flavorText: Where the sick are tended, civilisation endures.

WRITING.name: Writing
WRITING.description: Develop a writing system for record-keeping and knowledge preservation. +10% research; halves the upkeep overhead of running many properties.
WRITING.flavorText: With marks on clay, we conquered time itself.

PHILOSOPHY.name: Philosophy
PHILOSOPHY.description: Schools of thought that enrich culture and governance.
PHILOSOPHY.flavorText: The unexamined realm is not worth ruling.

DIPLOMACY_MASTERY.name: Diplomacy Mastery
DIPLOMACY_MASTERY.description: Advanced diplomatic techniques for treaties and alliances. +30% effective diplomacy; tribute and peace treaties cost 20% less.
DIPLOMACY_MASTERY.flavorText: Words, well placed, can accomplish what armies cannot.

UNIVERSITY.name: University
UNIVERSITY.description: Found a great university to accelerate all research.
UNIVERSITY.flavorText: Knowledge multiplies when minds gather under one roof.

PRINTING_PRESS.name: Printing Press
PRINTING_PRESS.description: Mass-produce books and spread literacy across the realm.
PRINTING_PRESS.flavorText: A single press can topple empires — or build them.

ESPIONAGE.name: Espionage
ESPIONAGE.description: Train spies and establish intelligence networks.
ESPIONAGE.flavorText: The truest weapon is the one your enemy never sees.

HEAVY_CAVALRY.name: Heavy Cavalry
HEAVY_CAVALRY.description: Armored knights on warhorses — the ultimate shock force.

PLATE_ARMOR.name: Plate Armor
PLATE_ARMOR.description: Full plate armor provides extraordinary protection: enemies strike 15% weaker and 15% fewer of your soldiers die.
PLATE_ARMOR.flavorText: Encased in steel, a single knight becomes a fortress.

CROSSBOW.name: Crossbow
CROSSBOW.description: Mechanical bows that penetrate heavy armor: ranged units hit 25% harder (scaled by their share of your army).
CROSSBOW.flavorText: Even a peasant with a crossbow can fell a knight.

WINDMILL.name: Windmill
WINDMILL.description: Harness wind power for grinding grain and pumping water.
WINDMILL.flavorText: What the wind gives freely, the wise put to work.

GLASSMAKING.name: Glassmaking
GLASSMAKING.description: Produce glass for windows, lenses, and trade goods.
GLASSMAKING.flavorText: From sand, something wondrous — clear as water, hard as stone.

DEEP_MINING.name: Deep Mining
DEEP_MINING.description: Mine deeper veins for rare ores and gems.
DEEP_MINING.flavorText: The deeper we dig, the richer the earth becomes.

IRRIGATED_FARM.name: Irrigated Farm
IRRIGATED_FARM.description: Irrigated farmland produces abundant grain even in arid regions. Upkeep: 8g/day

GRANARY.name: Granary
GRANARY.description: Stores the harvest safely: your farms within 1 hex produce +20% and lose only half as much to droughts and floods. Upkeep: 3g/day

FOUNDRY.name: Foundry
FOUNDRY.description: Advanced metalworking facility. Produces refined metals. Upkeep: 20g/day

WATER_MILL.name: Water Mill
WATER_MILL.description: Water-powered mill that grinds flour or saws firewood. +50% output on a river. Upkeep: 8g/day

QUARRY.name: Quarry
QUARRY.description: Extracts building stone from the earth. Upkeep: 12g/day

WATCHTOWER.name: Watchtower
WATCHTOWER.description: Keeps watch over everything within 4 hexes, wherever you are. Upkeep: 5g/day

MERCHANT_GUILD.name: Merchant Guild
MERCHANT_GUILD.description: A guild hall that adds +10% to all your trade profits (up to 3 halls). Upkeep: 15g/day

SHIPYARD.name: Shipyard
SHIPYARD.description: Repairs your ships docked beside it by 5% a day, free. Upkeep: 12g/day

FISHING_FLEET.name: Fishing Fleet
FISHING_FLEET.description: A fleet of fishing boats harvesting the deep sea. Upkeep: 8g/day

LIGHTHOUSE.name: Lighthouse
LIGHTHOUSE.description: Guides ships in safely: +15% on cargo you sell at a port beside it. Upkeep: 5g/day

HOSPITAL.name: Hospital
HOSPITAL.description: Treats the sick and wounded: you heal 15 health a day while within 2 hexes. Upkeep: 10g/day

UNIVERSITY.name: University
UNIVERSITY.description: A center of higher learning: research takes 25% less time (up to 2 universities). Upkeep: 18g/day

WINDMILL.name: Windmill
WINDMILL.description: A tall wind-powered mill that grinds grain into flour faster than a basic Mill. Upkeep: 5g/day

LONGBOWMAN.name: Longbowman
LONGBOWMAN.description: Elite ranged unit with devastating volleys: up to +6% power against melee-heavy foes

CAVALRY.name: Light Cavalry
CAVALRY.description: Fast mounted units, excellent for flanking and pursuit

SIEGE_ENGINE.name: Siege Engine
SIEGE_ENGINE.description: Devastating siege weapons: +40% army power when raiding or besieging a settlement (max +100%)

WARSHIP.name: Warship
WARSHIP.description: Armed vessel for naval combat and coastal raids

HEAVY_CAVALRY.name: Heavy Cavalry
HEAVY_CAVALRY.description: Heavily armored mounted knights — devastating shock troops

CROSSBOWMAN.name: Crossbowman
CROSSBOWMAN.description: Armored ranged unit with armor-piercing bolts

STEEL_WEAPONS.name: Forge Steel Weapons
STEEL_WEAPONS.description: Forge superior steel weapons worth more.

STEEL_ARMOR.name: Forge Steel Armor
STEEL_ARMOR.description: Forge protective steel armor and equipment.

PLATE_ARMOR_SET.name: Forge Plate Armor
PLATE_ARMOR_SET.description: Craft full suits of plate armor for elite warriors.

GLASS_GOODS.name: Produce Glass Goods
GLASS_GOODS.description: Craft valuable glass items for trade and construction.

tax_collector.name: Tax Collector
tax_collector.description: You are charged with visiting settlements and collecting taxes on behalf of the crown. A thankless but lucrative office.

duties.description: Visit at least 3 kingdom settlements and collect taxes each month.

jailer.name: Jailer
jailer.description: You are the keeper of the kingdom's dungeons. Hunt fugitives, capture criminals, and deliver them to the nearest jail.

duties.description: Capture at least 1 fugitive and bring them to justice each month.

marshal.name: Marshal
marshal.description: Commander of the kingdom's military patrols. Defend the realm, clear bandits from the roads, and escort caravans.

duties.description: Complete at least 4 patrols through kingdom territory each month.

spymaster.name: Spymaster
spymaster.description: Master of whispers and shadows. Gather intelligence on rival kingdoms, uncover plots, and manage the kingdom's informant network.

duties.description: Gather at least 2 pieces of foreign intelligence each month.

court_chaplain.name: Court Chaplain
court_chaplain.description: Spiritual advisor to the court. Tend to the kingdom's faith, bless the people, and maintain holy sites.

duties.description: Visit and bless at least 2 kingdom settlements each month.

trade_envoy.name: Trade Envoy
trade_envoy.description: Official representative of the kingdom's trade interests. Negotiate deals, establish trade routes, and bring prosperity.

duties.description: Complete at least 2 trade missions to foreign kingdoms each month.

royal_cartographer.name: Royal Cartographer
royal_cartographer.description: Official mapmaker of the realm. Explore uncharted territory, survey borders, and expand the kingdom's knowledge of the world.

duties.description: Explore and survey at least 20 new tiles each month.

chancellor.name: Chancellor
chancellor.description: Chief advisor to the ruler and overseer of the kingdom's affairs. The highest non-royal office, with authority over all other officials.

duties.description: Hold court at the capital and maintain kingdom stability each month.

DROUGHT.name: Severe Drought
DROUGHT.description: A prolonged drought scorches the land, devastating crops and drying rivers.
DROUGHT.text: A terrible drought grips {region}. Crops wither and wells run dry.

PLAGUE.name: Plague Outbreak
PLAGUE.description: A devastating plague sweeps through settlements, killing thousands.
PLAGUE.text: Plague has broken out in {settlement}! The dead are piling up in the streets.

FLOOD.name: Great Flood
FLOOD.description: Rivers burst their banks, flooding farmland and washing away roads.
FLOOD.text: Devastating floods ravage the lowlands near {settlement}.

EARTHQUAKE.name: Earthquake
EARTHQUAKE.description: The earth shakes violently, toppling buildings and opening fissures.
EARTHQUAKE.text: A mighty earthquake strikes near {settlement}! Buildings crumble and the earth splits.

BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST.name: Bountiful Harvest
BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST.description: Ideal weather conditions produce a bumper harvest across the realm.
BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST.text: The harvest in {region} is the best in living memory! Granaries overflow.

GOLD_RUSH.name: Gold Rush
GOLD_RUSH.description: Rich gold deposits are discovered, drawing prospectors from across the realm.
GOLD_RUSH.text: Gold has been discovered near {settlement}! Prospectors flood into the region.

TRADE_BOOM.name: Trade Boom
TRADE_BOOM.description: A flourishing period of trade enriches merchants and kingdoms alike.
TRADE_BOOM.text: Trade flourishes across {region}. Merchants report record profits.

MARKET_CRASH.name: Market Crash
MARKET_CRASH.description: A sudden collapse in trade confidence sends markets into freefall.
MARKET_CRASH.text: Markets crash across {region}! Merchants are ruined and prices plummet.

PIRATE_SURGE.name: Pirate Surge
PIRATE_SURGE.description: Pirates grow bold and numerous, threatening coastal trade.
PIRATE_SURGE.text: Pirates terrorize the shipping lanes near {settlement}. Sea trade grinds to a halt.

BANDIT_UPRISING.name: Bandit Uprising
BANDIT_UPRISING.description: Organized bandit gangs terrorize the countryside.
BANDIT_UPRISING.text: Bandits have formed an organized gang near {settlement}. The roads are unsafe.

KINGDOM_WAR.name: Kingdom War
KINGDOM_WAR.description: Two kingdoms go to war, dragging their neighbors into the conflict.
KINGDOM_WAR.text: {kingdom1} declares war on {kingdom2}! Armies march to battle.

REBELLION.name: Peasant Rebellion
REBELLION.description: Oppressed peasants rise up against their lords.
REBELLION.text: The peasants of {settlement} have risen in rebellion against {kingdom}!

SUCCESSION_CRISIS.name: Succession Crisis
SUCCESSION_CRISIS.description: The death of a ruler without a clear heir throws a kingdom into turmoil.
SUCCESSION_CRISIS.text: The ruler of {kingdom} has died without a clear heir. Rival claimants vie for the throne.

DIPLOMATIC_MARRIAGE.name: Royal Wedding
DIPLOMATIC_MARRIAGE.description: A royal marriage unites two houses and eases tensions between kingdoms.
DIPLOMATIC_MARRIAGE.text: A grand wedding celebration! {kingdom1} and {kingdom2} forge an alliance through marriage.

RELIGIOUS_SCHISM.name: Religious Schism
RELIGIOUS_SCHISM.description: A major split within a faith divides believers and sows discord.
RELIGIOUS_SCHISM.text: A schism erupts within the {faith}! Believers are forced to choose sides.

HOLY_CRUSADE.name: Holy Crusade
HOLY_CRUSADE.description: Religious leaders call for a holy war to reclaim sacred territory.
HOLY_CRUSADE.text: A crusade is declared! The faithful rally to reclaim the holy lands.

COMET_SIGHTING.name: Comet Sighting
COMET_SIGHTING.description: A blazing comet streaks across the sky. Some see it as a blessing, others a curse.
COMET_SIGHTING.text: A comet appears in the night sky! Priests debate its meaning while the commoners tremble.

ECLIPSE.name: Solar Eclipse
ECLIPSE.description: The sun goes dark in the middle of the day, spreading fear and awe — and driving the frightened to the temples.
ECLIPSE.text: The sun is swallowed by darkness! An eclipse throws the realm into momentary panic.

MONSTER_SIGHTING.name: Monster Sighting
MONSTER_SIGHTING.description: A fearsome creature is sighted in the wilds, threatening travelers and settlements.
MONSTER_SIGHTING.text: A terrible beast has been sighted near {settlement}! Brave warriors are needed.

FESTIVAL.name: Grand Festival
FESTIVAL.description: A grand celebration brings joy and commerce to the realm.
FESTIVAL.text: {kingdom} celebrates a grand festival! Music, food, and merriment fill the streets.

REFUGEE_WAVE.name: Refugee Wave
REFUGEE_WAVE.description: War or disaster drives refugees to seek shelter in neighboring kingdoms.
REFUGEE_WAVE.text: Refugees pour into {settlement}, fleeing turmoil. They bring labor but strain resources.

VOLCANIC_ERUPTION.name: Volcanic Eruption
VOLCANIC_ERUPTION.description: A volcano erupts, raining ash and fire upon the surrounding lands.
VOLCANIC_ERUPTION.text: A volcano erupts with cataclysmic fury! Ash blots out the sun across {region}.

BLIZZARD.name: Great Blizzard
BLIZZARD.description: An unseasonably fierce blizzard blankets the land in deep snow.
BLIZZARD.text: A terrible blizzard sweeps across {region}. Roads are impassable and livestock freeze.

FAMINE.name: Hungry Months
FAMINE.description: Last year's stores run out before the new crop is in. Bread is dear and tempers short. Most likely in the lean weeks of late winter and early spring.
FAMINE.text: The granaries of {region} are bare. Hunger stalks the lean months.

slander.label: Slander
slander.description: {victim} tells anyone who will listen that {perpetrator} is a coward and a cheat ({location})

merchant_slander.label: Merchant Slander
merchant_slander.description: {victim} warn the market that {perpetrator}'s company pays late and sells short weight ({location})

contract_broken.label: Broken Contract
contract_broken.description: {perpetrator} promised {victim} goods for {location} and never delivered

famine_dole.label: Famine Dole
famine_dole.description: {perpetrator} fed the hungry of {location} from their own treasury

brave.name: Brave
brave.description: Charges first and fights to the last. Soldiers follow you gladly.
greetings: *straightens up* They say you never take a step back in battle.
The bards already sing of your courage, friend.

craven.name: Craven
craven.description: Your army has broken and run too often. Men whisper that you flee first.
greetings: *smirks* Off to run from another fight?

cruel.name: Cruel
cruel.description: You hurt the weak and enjoy it. Fear opens doors; affection closes them.
greetings: *keeps a careful distance* I've heard what you did to those people.

merciful.name: Merciful
merciful.description: You spare the beaten and feed the hungry. The common folk remember kindness.
greetings: *smiles warmly* You're the one who helped the poor folk, aren't you?

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.description: Every coin is yours to take. Merchants haggle hard with you, and everyone counts their purse.
greetings: *clutches purse* What do you want this time?

generous.name: Generous
generous.description: Open-handed with coin and drink. People are glad to see you coming.
greetings: Ah, the open-handed one! Drinks are on you again, I hope?

pious.name: Pious
pious.description: Prayer, pilgrimage and miracles have marked you as devout. The clergy count you among their own.
greetings: *bows head* Blessings upon you, faithful one.

zealous.name: Zealous
zealous.description: You burn heresy and preach without rest. The devout adore you; everyone else is wary.
greetings: *glances nervously* No heretics here, I swear it.

cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.description: Spies, informants and schemes. You know things others don't.
greetings: *lowers voice* I hear you always know more than you let on.

honest.name: Honest
honest.description: You keep your word: quests finished, contracts honoured, alliances kept.
greetings: Your word is good, they say. That's rare these days.

deceitful.name: Deceitful
deceitful.description: Broken oaths and slipped bonds. Nobody quite trusts what you say.
greetings: *narrows eyes* I'll count my change twice, thank you.

merchant_prince.name: Merchant Prince
merchant_prince.description: Your trade fortune is the talk of every market. Guilds deal with you as an equal.
greetings: A pleasure! Every merchant from here to the coast knows your name.

sea_wolf.name: Sea Wolf
sea_wolf.description: Pirates hunted and sea battles won. Sailors fear and admire you.
greetings: *eyes your weathered hands* You've the salt of the sea on you, captain.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: Research, lore and ancient ruins. Learned folk seek your opinion.
greetings: Ah, the scholar! Is it true you read every tome you find?

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.description: Dice at every tavern. Fortune favours you a little — and debt follows you a lot.
greetings: *rattles dice* Fancy a round, friend? I hear you never refuse.

drunkard.name: Drunkard
drunkard.description: More nights in the tavern than out of it. Good company, poor counsel.
greetings: *grins* Back for another round, are we?

beloved.name: Beloved of the People
beloved.description: Festivals, fair taxes and open hands. The commons would follow you anywhere.
greetings: *beams* It's an honour! My mother still talks about your festival.

dread_lord.name: Dread Lord
dread_lord.description: Conquest, raids and threats. People do what you say — and love you not at all.
greetings: *trembles* W-whatever you need, my lord. Please.
*won't meet your eye* I've done nothing wrong, I swear it.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.description: You've seen more of the world than most kings. Strangers warm to a well-travelled face.
greetings: A traveller! Where have your roads taken you lately?

kinslayer.name: Kinslayer
kinslayer.description: You raised your sword against the realm you married into. Such a stain never washes out.
greetings: *spits* Kinslayer. The gods see what you did.

champion.name: Champion of Tournaments
champion.description: Lists and archery butts: you win them. Nobles want you at their feasts.
greetings: *gasps* The champion of the lists! May I shake your hand?

scarred.name: Scarred
scarred.description: An old wound left its mark across your face. Hard men respect it; most folk look away.
greetings: *stares at your scar, then quickly away* G-good day to you.
*nods at the scar* Saw some fighting, eh?

lame.name: Lame
lame.description: A badly healed wound left you with a limp: one less hex on the road each day, and people pity you a little.
greetings: *watches you limp in* Sit, sit — rest that leg.

land_dispute.title: The Moved Boundary Stone
land_dispute.text: Two farmers of {settlement}, {name} and {name2}, each swear the other moved the boundary stone between their fields by night. The harvest of a whole strip hangs on your word.

ignore.result: With no ruling, the quarrel turned to fists at the market cross.

choices.label: Send a surveyor to find the true line
choices.result: Your surveyor traces the old charter line. Both men grumble, but both accept it.

choices.label: Split the strip down the middle
choices.result: Neither man is satisfied — which the village takes as a fair sign.

choices.label: Declare the strip crown land
choices.result: The strip is yours now. Both farmers curse you, for once in agreement.

guild_monopoly.title: The Clothiers' Charter
guild_monopoly.text: {name}, master of the clothiers' guild of {settlement}, lays a heavy purse before you. The guild asks for sole right to sell cloth in the town — no peddlers, no foreign bolts.

ignore.result: The guild takes your silence as contempt.

choices.label: Grant the monopoly and take the purse
choices.result: The guild's purse is heavy. The price of cloth will soon be heavier.

choices.label: Grant a five-year charter for a fee
choices.result: A charter with an end date — the guild grumbles at the terms and pays.

choices.label: Refuse: the market stays open
choices.result: The peddlers cheer. The guild masters do not.

merchant_venturers.title: The Merchant Venturers
merchant_venturers.text: {name}, spokesman of the merchant venturers of {settlement}, asks that your House charter a trading company under its own seal — posts, factors and contracts in your name — rather than leave the trade to foreign houses.

ignore.result: The venturers took their ledgers to a rival house.

choices.label: Seal a charter for your own company
choices.result: The charter is sealed. Your House may found a trading company (Trading Company, in any town).

choices.label: Sell the venturers a charter of their own
choices.result: The venturers pay handsomely and trade under their own seal.

choices.label: Trade is no business of a lord
choices.result: The venturers bow stiffly and leave.

famine_plea.title: Empty Granaries
famine_plea.text: A delegation from {settlement}, led by the reeve {name}, kneels in the snow. The stores will not last the season; children are already going hungry.

ignore.result: No help came. Some starved; more left.

choices.label: Buy grain from the treasury
choices.result: Carts of grain roll into {settlement}. They will remember who fed them.

choices.label: Requisition the merchants' stores
choices.result: Your soldiers open the merchants' cellars. The poor eat; the merchants count their losses.

choices.label: Send the hungry to the temples' charity
choices.result: The priests feed whom they can. It is not enough, but it is something.

choices.label: Refuse — the treasury is not a granary
choices.result: The delegation leaves in silence. The winter does the rest.

drought_plea.title: The Wells Run Dry
drought_plea.text: The summer has been merciless around {settlement}. {name} asks that you pay diggers for a deep well before the cattle die.

ignore.result: The cattle died in the dry fields.

choices.label: Pay for the deep well
choices.result: Sweet water at forty feet. {settlement} drinks to your health.

choices.label: Order prayers for rain

success.result: Rain falls three days later. The priests say it was you; you let them.

failure.result: The sky stays brass. The prayers are not answered.

choices.result: Bells ring and censers swing across {settlement}.

choices.label: Make the town share the old well by lot
choices.result: A fair rota, grimly kept.

heretic_preacher.title: The Hedge Preacher
heretic_preacher.text: A wild-eyed preacher, {name}, draws crowds in the square of {settlement}, denouncing {faith} as a lie of the rich. The priests demand you silence him.

ignore.result: Unchecked, the preacher's crowds grew — and so did the priests' anger.

choices.label: Expel him from the town
choices.result: {name} is marched to the boundary stones. His followers watch in silence.

choices.label: Imprison him for sedition
choices.result: The cell door shuts. The square is quiet — for now.

choices.label: Let him preach — words are not crimes
choices.result: {name} goes on preaching, freely and loudly.

choices.label: Debate him before the crowd

success.result: You take his arguments apart one by one. The crowd laughs him out of town.

failure.result: He is quicker than you. The crowd laughs — at you.

choices.result: You climb the steps of the market cross.
